steps_h2: How to Make a Product Launch Video in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: Leave with an announcement clip: open the frame, set the jar and the sentence, and download.

steps.d: The frame is already an announcement, with a gap where the jar sits. You fill that gap instead of building the ad from nothing.
Use one photo of the sealed jar or paste the product page link. The copy reflects the lid color and ship date.
Place the jar with an AI avatar, then show its name in captions. A long pause before the name can be cut in the editor.

faq.q: What does a launch ad template include?
faq.a: A reveal frame for one finished item, like a sneaker whose box opens on camera. An AI avatar can do that reveal. You write the sentence that goes with it.

faq.q: How does a launch template become a clip?
faq.a: Give it the lamp photo and the sentence you want said. The clip comes back sized for a post. Shorten it if the reveal takes too long.

faq.q: Why template a launch instead of filming a creator?
faq.a: You can fix the sentence on launch week without calling a presenter back. A filmed shoot locks that sentence to one afternoon, and a color name on the box may still change.

faq.q: Who should use a launch template?
faq.a: A shop shipping its fourth snack tin, or a founder whose first watch goes out next week. You need a finished item and a sentence. You do not need to book a studio.

faq.q: Can a first-timer run a launch template?
faq.a: Yes. A phone picture of the sealed box is enough to start, even if you have never edited a video.

faq.q: Which kinds of releases fit this template?
faq.a: Beauty drops, home goods, gadgets, food, fitness gear, and other shop products. Change the item and the line when the buyer changes.

faq.q: Can older shop files go into the launch?
faq.a: Yes. Last year's unboxing clip and the mark from your label can sit beside the new kettle. Use a photo of the item you will actually ship.

faq.q: Which channels can the launch clip fit?
faq.a: A 16:9 file fits a wide placement, and a 9:16 file fits a phone story. Square 1:1 is there for a feed tile, with 4:3 and 3:4 beside them. YouTube can take the wide file. Facebook can take the square.

faq.q: Does using a template require payment?
faq.a: Yes. Templates are on a paid subscription. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600. Clips spend 24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15, and 120 for 30. A failed job returns its credits.

faq.q: Can the launch clip run in ads and for clients?
faq.a: Yes. Hand the file to a client, or run it as a paid post. No watermark is printed on the download. The license is the one on your plan.

faq.q: Why start from a template instead of an empty edit?
faq.a: The shape is already a reveal, so the hour goes into the serum and the shade name. An empty edit has no announcement in it yet.
